human.title: Breaking In
human.desc: It’s been 9 years since the last invasion. Relearn the ropes of battle from our highest ranking officer, Johnny Rockit

messages.text: Perfect, communications are online!
Okay {player}, I'll talk to you through here now.
Watch out, here they come!
AHHHRRG! Take that!
Hey, remmeber to use your ability if you're low on ammo!
Just a few more, let's show 'em what we're made of!

human.title: Survivor Lookout
human.desc: One week ago we lost communications with our military ship Echo-1. We believe it was attacked and there may be survivors in a zombie quarantine zone. Go check it out but be warned, there’s been reports of many zombies in the area.

messages.text: What... There's no one here?
I have a bad feeling about this...
Ah, I found one! Kill it!
Wait a second, more are coming. Stay sharp!
There's too many of them! Keep shooting!
We're surrounded! We need an evacuation! Repeat, we need an Evac Now!
Roger, Evac is on it's way. Hold tight guys.
messages.speaker: Dani

messages.text: Landing zone is too hot, kill as many as you can and we'll pick you up!
messages.speaker: Dani

messages.text: Roger that, let's do this {player}!

human.title: Sweep and Clear
human.desc: We’re sending you back in more equipped for the situation. This time you’ll have flame throwers and new, flame resistant armor. Clear the city of infected and secure any survivors.

messages.text: A survivor? Are you from the crashed Echo-1?
Yes I'm the captain, please get out of here!
Copy that, lets clear out these zombies and I'll call for evac.
Alright lets clean this place up!
Keep your eyes peeled for any survivors
Hey, don't shoot!

human.title: Cause and Effect
human.desc: Play as Captain Biggs one week ago, and watch the events that caused his Echo-1 ship to crash, and start the whole alien invasion.

messages.text: What the... Why did they attack us?
AI, what's the ship status?
Mainframe: Offline.
Thrusters: Offline.
Autocannons: Offline.
Communications: Offline.
Escape Pods: ...
Escape Pods: Operational.
Well at least the... Incoming! Open fire!
What's going on here, why would they attack us?
Help me kill these aliens fast...
I need to warn the people of earth!
Affirmative.

human.title: Retrieval
human.desc: The aliens must be attacking because they think we have their artifacts. Retrieve them from the crashed wreckage so we can return them and end this war once and for all.

messages.text: Intruder alert.
Intruder alert.\nDestroy intruders.
What, us? We're on your side!
Verification failed.\nDestroy intruders.
This is no use, we need to get those artifacts!
Woohoo! Keep it up, almost done!

human.title: New Recruits
human.desc: Before we give back the artifacts, we’re having our top scientists look into them. There has to be a reason the aliens want them so badly. In the meantime, show our new recruits how it’s done against some training bots in our testing dome.

messages.text: Alright recruits, listen up.
messages.speaker: Instructor

messages.text: {player} here is our top soldier, so take notes.
messages.speaker: Instructor

messages.text: What's going on, why does everyone keep switching teams?
messages.speaker: Recruit

messages.text: This is Juggernaught. Everyone is teamed up against the Juggernaught.
messages.speaker: Instructor

messages.text: If you kill the Juggernaught, you become the Juggernaught.
messages.speaker: Instructor

messages.text: Oh right, I get it.
messages.speaker: Recruit

messages.text: Ohh nicely done, did everyone see that?
messages.speaker: Instructor

messages.text: Man, this guy is good...
messages.speaker: Recruit

messages.text: Wow perfect, just perfect.
messages.speaker: Instructor

human.title: Hold the fort
human.desc: Our researchers are still looking into the power of the artifacts, but the aliens have discovered the underwater lab. Go there and secure the artifacts, we can’t let them go until we know their full potential.

messages.text: Thank god you're here! They're trying to steal the artifacts!
messages.speaker: Scientist

messages.text: No problem brutha, we'll lock these babies down!
Land Mines detected, Proceed with caution.
Eugh ah, achoo!
I hate wearing suits.
But until I can breath underwater, I guess I have no choice.
Yes, this is looking good... Keep defending those artifacts!
messages.speaker: Scientist

messages.text: I need more time... Just a little longer...
messages.speaker: Scientist

messages.text: Almost done...
messages.speaker: Scientist

human.title: My First Mission
human.desc: Alien shipyards have been discovered in the desert. They’re actually building more ships on our planet. Take the new recruits on their very first mission and show ‘em how it’s done by getting the most kills on your team.

messages.text: Alright, you guys ready to see how a real pro does it?
Show 'em how it's done {player}
Hey, what are you guys doin'? Introduce yourselves!
Oh right uh... Field Medic, reporting for duty!
I'm Treem the Explosives Specialist.
Best stay far from me unless you want to get burned.
That's it? Well you already know me, expert at close quarters combat.
Watch out for those land mines guys, they're everywhere!
Woooohooo! I can get used to this!
Hah, they burn so easily.

human.title: Shocking Discovery
human.desc: We’ve found out the true nature of the artifacts but it seems that the aliens have found their location once again, they seem to be giving out some sort of GPS signal. Secure the artifacts at all costs.

messages.text: Okay we're here, let's do this!
Wait wait, there's no one else here...
Yeah, they all got scared and ran home to mama!
No, something doesn't feel right...
Ambush! Open fire!
What, how did they do that?
They seem to be using some sort of cloaking device, stay alert!

human.title: Strange Encounter
human.desc: We've lost communications with the Ship Yards and we fear the worst... Your team is currently busy on other assignments, so you'll have to check it out alone.

messages.text: Greetings human.
What, surprised I speak your language?
We know what you're planning with the artifacts.
We will not stop until they are in our posession.
Earth will be destroyed, we will prevail.
Hah hah hah. You're wasting your time human.
Surrender now, there is no chance for your race.
Silence? Your race usually can not stop speaking.
This is pointless.
You Will Fail.

human.title: Trapped
human.desc: Go to the mines to place the first artifact. There’s too many zombies in the area, so you’ll need to place the artifact while you fight. Your team is still busy on another assignment, but will soon come to assist you.

messages.text: Braaiinnns...
Brraaiins?
Braaiinnns!
... Aaarrtifaacct...
Aarrtifact...
Sorry we're late. Did ya miss us?
Woo, let's light 'em up!

human.title: Disposal
human.desc: One of the artifacts was already placed and activated in the underwater lab but it's now being attacked. Wipe out all enemies in the lab!

messages.text: Sorry, I won't be joining you guys...
messages.speaker: Ex.

messages.text: Water really gives me the creeps...
messages.speaker: Ex.

messages.text: Worry not. My assistance will be given instead.

human.title: Reclaimed
human.desc: Aliens have discovered the location of our first artifact and are removing it. Head back to the mines and steal it back at all costs. You will receive help from the mine security bots.

messages.text: Alright guys, plain and simple. You know what to do.
Tear 'em up!

human.title: Mutation
human.desc: Place the 3rd artifact. The virus is starting to take effect, you can feel something changing inside you...

messages.text: Whoa what, this thing is teleporting all over the place!
I can't hit him, he's like a monkey on sugar!
Heh, explosives always seem to do the trick.
Right, explosives or strong weapons should take him down easily!

human.title: Final Deployment
human.desc: The final artifact is ready to be placed. Defeat the enemy with only minutes until the meteor shower hits. You have fully mutated into a Zombie, but the survival of the human race lies within your hands.

messages.text: This is our last shot, we need to kill them before the Meteors hit.
If we can't activate the last artifact in time, earth is doomed...
We have exactly 4 minutes before it's too late... We can do this!
Before I die... Kill them, please... Kill them all...
I've.. learned so much... Thankyou...
Eugh, it's... been an honor fighting by your side...

alien.title: Misscommunication
alien.desc: A human ship has been spotted near our artifact transport ship. Remove all human threats, as the artifacts must travel safely back to our home planet.

messages.text: This human must die.
We can't allow him to notify his people about our attack.
Human reinforcements is the last thing we need.
Target acquired.
Fight past the machines, defend the artifact with your life!
Their defenses are too strong. We are underequipped!
No, fight as a team, and we will prevail!

alien.title: Search Party
alien.desc: The artifacts are no longer in our ship, search the surrounding wreckage for them.

messages.text: Those artifacts are a top priority. Search every corner.
Intruder Alert.
These bots are nothing but scrap metal. Kill them and keep searching!
Identify systems malfunction.
Targeting systems malfunction.
Rebooting all Transport Bots...
Here's our chance to search uninterrupted!
Reboot status: 50%
Reboot status: 75%
Reboot Complete. All systems 100%.
Identifaction database not found.
Defaulting all personel to 'Intruder' status.
Great, that should slow down anyone that comes after us.

alien.title: Invasion
alien.desc: The artifacts can not be found... The human must have taken them. Our first plan of action is to destroy their main combat facility.

messages.text: Oh no!
What is it commander?
It's the one they call... 'Raze'
In our first invasion attempt, we fought an elite group.
We killed them all off except this one.
This man single handedly defeated us...
Not this time. The artifacts will be ours once again!

alien.title: Epidemic
alien.desc: We’ve located the escape pod from the survivor on that ship, it's in the infected city. We must find him and retrieve the artifacts before the humans do!

messages.text: Stay sharp. We must capture the survivor.
I don't understand... Was it not our species who created this virus?
Why are they attacking us.
Alllliiiennnn braaaaiinnnnnnnnnnsssssss
We haven't paid earth a visit in many years. The infected now follow no one.
BRAIIIINS
The intelectual level of these creatures is... embarrising... to say the least.
Enough! Capture the survivor and secure the artifacts!

alien.title: Discipline
alien.desc: The humans have escaped with the survivor and artifacts. Zombies are no longer allied with us, so head over to the thickest zombie infestation in attempt to gain their loyalty. You'll have to do this alone.

messages.text: Commander, we've supplied you with a highly delicious brain.
messages.speaker: Alien

messages.text: The zombies will all be fighting for it.
messages.speaker: Alien

messages.text: You need to take the brain, and kill them all.
messages.speaker: Alien

messages.text: What?
This will show your dominence over them.
messages.speaker: Alien

messages.text: Right, will do.

alien.title: Breaking Point
alien.desc: We've finally trained the undead to fight along side our soldiers. Our tracking on the artifacts is now working, and we've located them at an underwater facility.

messages.text: Watch your step commrads. The security bots are leaving land mines everywhere.
Well well well... Look what I have found.
Leave me alone... I... I don't know anything!
messages.speaker: Scientist

messages.text: Leave him!
A war is not what we want. Our only focus is the artifacts.
That human has no use to us. Let him go.
Ugh... What... They're letting me go?
messages.speaker: Scientist

alien.title: A Strong Defense
alien.desc: In an attempt to build our offenses on Earth we’ve began ship production on various locations. However it appears the humans have found us out. We’re equipping everyone on the team with Acid hounds, so be careful where you fire.

messages.text: We must defend our ships at all cost!
The one they call 'Raze'... He's back. Was he not killed?
Commander, we can't kill him. No matter what we do, he always escapes...
Hmph, impressive...

alien.title: Underestimated
alien.desc: The humans are attempting to place one of the artifacts. Stop them at all costs!

messages.text: The humans are placing the first artifact. We must stop them!
Arrrttiifffaccctt..

alien.title: The Ambush
alien.desc: We've failed to retrieve the artifact from the mines. Use your cloaking to ambush their facility in the north. If we destroy it, it might distrupt their communications.

messages.text: Alright men, get into position.
The humans are here, get equipped and be ready to strike...
Ready...
Attack!

alien.title: Tormented
alien.desc: We’ve developed a new technology that allows us to teleport around the field during battle. We purposely sent out a distress call to lure the humans to the shipyards.

messages.text: Greetings human.
What, surprised I speak your language?
We know what you're planning with the artifacts.
We will not stop until they are in our posession.
Earth will be destroyed, we will prevail.
Hah hah hah. You're wasting your time human.
Surrender now, there is no chance for your race.
Silence? Your race usually can not stop speaking.
This is pointless.
You Will Fail.

alien.title: Artifact Retrieval 101
alien.desc: The humans are placing th 2nd artifact in their underwater facility! Steal the artifact and bring it back to us.

messages.text: Commander, we're outnumbered!
Right, so you'll need to be strategic.
Find the fastest and safest route, and stick to it!
Yes commander!

alien.title: Taking out the Trash
alien.desc: The humans have been using one of their domes as a training grounds for soldiers. Eliminate the soldiers to ensure their army does not grow any stronger.

messages.text: I thought these were supposed to be new recruits!
Looks like they've been training hard...
Wipe 'em out.

alien.title: The Pickup
alien.desc: We've received word that the carrier ship we shot down was carrying a very powerful weapon called "Frozen Death". Go secure the weapon. Wipe out any resistance you encouner.

messages.text: Just like last time, search all corners of this ship!
We need to find that weapon.

alien.title: Rocket Race
alien.desc: The humans have placed 2 of the 4 artifacts, and are about to place the third. Use the recovered weapon "Frozen Death" to kill them before they can place the artifact.

messages.text: Now to try this thing out...
Commander, that weapon... it's incredible!
Would be excellent in other battles!
Seems like it only works in this cold weather.
I don't think I can take it on our next mission.

alien.title: A Soldiers Demise
alien.desc: The Humans are placing the final artifact and the meteors are imminent. I'm afraid it's too late for our planet... Take 2 other Commanders, we must do what we can.

messages.text: This is it, fellow Commanders.
The meteors are heading our way... We have only 4 minutes.
The one known as 'Raze'... He seems to have mutated into a powerful form.
Kill the others first, I want him all to myself.
